Greatmark Investment Partners Has Boosted Biogen (BIIB) Position; Thomaspartners Increases Holding in Starbucks (SBUX)
April 27, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Greatmark Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Biogen Inc (BIIB) by 39.83% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc bought 950 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 3,335 shares of the biological products (no diagnostic substances) company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.06M, up from 2,385 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Biogen Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $58.39 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $2.12 during the last trading session, reaching $275.98. About 696,020 shares traded. Biogen Inc. (NASDAQ:BIIB) has declined 3.66% since April 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.21% the S&P500.
